purpose: Determine whether the newly discovered SSRN paper titled Risk Control as the Durable Edge supplies a distinct stable Binance BTC ETH SOL direction-independent edge or changes the retained terminal cross-sectional funding-dispersion decision.

paper_discovery.title: Risk Control as the Durable Edge: Loss Filtering, Profit-Armed Ratchets, and Market-Neutral Carry When Direction Fails
paper_discovery.author: Alexandr Dashyan
discovery_only_observations_not_used_as_: the abstract describes a cross-sectional dollar-neutral funding-carry sleeve with beta close to zero
the abstract says the sleeve loses in three of six calendar years
the abstract says the steady funding coupon is only six to fifteen percent annually while the crowded-name price spread makes and loses the rest
the abstract explicitly says none of the presented mechanisms reliably makes money

scope_mapping.repository_scope: BTC ETH and SOL Binance USD-M perpetual pairs only
scope_mapping.repository_dominance_result: Even an impossible interval-perfect-foresight funding orientation with zero switching cost, only 32 bips entry and exit, and optimistic equal 5x leverage lost 18.840831506849315068493150692 bips across validation plus test before relative-price liquidation and operating costs.

decision.reason: The paper discovery does not expose a source-bound exact method and its abstract describes materially unstable returns driven mostly by relative-price spread rather than a stable funding coupon. The retained scoped Binance BTC ETH SOL dominance bound is stronger for funding-only economics and remains negative under impossible foresight and optimistic leverage. Building or resampling another cross-sectional funding model would duplicate a terminal family without satisfying its literal retry trigger.
decision.retry_trigger: A source-bound material Binance funding fee execution portfolio-margin netting or capital-treatment change must first clear the retained full-risk deficit, or a fully source-bound materially distinct method must prove that it is not the terminal funding-dispersion family before any new market request.

efficiency_correction.future_instruction: Search this triage and the structural-edge registry before implementing any literature-described cross-sectional or dollar-neutral funding sleeve. Do not treat a paper title, Sharpe estimate, beta estimate, or market-neutral label as a distinct mechanism.
